scope: All parent and nested bullet markers in the four examinable unit-content Knowledge/Skills lists. Unit descriptions, general capabilities, assessment regulations and grade descriptions are handled in the edition/school-review register, not counted as teaching bullets. Official wording remains in the linked syllabus, not republished here.
locatorConvention: Editorial IDs, not official SCSA numbering. On each printed page, count bullet markers in the unit-content knowledge/skills lists from top to bottom, including parent/nested markers. Exclude the introductory content-area overview. PDF page is 1-based; printed page = PDF page minus 4.
